blocks.text: A former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) engineer charged with malversation alongside former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co told the Sandiganbayan on Tuesday that he had no knowledge of nighttime construction activities by a Co-linked company at a road dike in Naujan, Oriental Mindoro.
